purpose: One quality round: stronger opt-in accepted-agreement qualification, fuller observed teaching, and 36 routing contrast lessons. Old official tests are regression evidence after prior inspection. Fresh authored probes are separate diagnostics.

classical_baseline.calibration: LAC scores on the same conformal half used by System 1; no temperature fitting. No test tuning.

takeover.stream_order: Sort teaching and calibration rows together by SHA-256 of workload name, colon, normalized group digest; use at most the first 1000. Stop on promotion.
takeover.promotion: 95% accepted teacher agreement, 80% overall teacher agreement and 80% acceptance, each with exact lower bounds sharing a 95% confidence budget; normal fresh validation blocks and repeated-attempt spending. First attempt at 400 observations.

gemini_settings.output: JSON object containing one enumerated intent label

limits: Old published test sets have already been inspected: these are regression evaluations, not new independent tests.
Fresh authored probes share authorship with the new lessons and are diagnostics only.
Agreement with a teacher is not independent correctness. No new live teacher calls. A stricter requirement may correctly defer takeover.
routing_lessons: 36 new teaching cases; unchanged calibration and old evaluation. No additional tuning after the fresh diagnostic results.
